title: Ezra 8: The Company Returns And Fasts At Ahava
body:
Read the chapter → [Ezra 8](/bible/ezra/8)

**[Ezra 8:1-14](/bible/ezra/8#v1)**

> <sup>[1](/bible/ezra/8#v1)</sup> These are now the chief of their fathers, and this is the genealogy of them that went up with me from Babylon, in the reign of Artaxerxes the king.
>
> <sup>[2](/bible/ezra/8#v2)</sup> Of the sons of Phinehas; Gershom: of the sons of Ithamar; Daniel: of the sons of David; Hattush.
>
> <sup>[3](/bible/ezra/8#v3)</sup> Of the sons of Shechaniah, of the sons of Pharosh; Zechariah: and with him were reckoned by genealogy of the males an hundred and fifty.
>
> <sup>[4](/bible/ezra/8#v4)</sup> Of the sons of Pahath–moab; Elihoenai the son of Zerahiah, and with him two hundred males.
>
> <sup>[5](/bible/ezra/8#v5)</sup> Of the sons of Shechaniah; the son of Jahaziel, and with him three hundred males.
>
> <sup>[6](/bible/ezra/8#v6)</sup> Of the sons also of Adin; Ebed the son of Jonathan, and with him fifty males.
>
> <sup>[7](/bible/ezra/8#v7)</sup> And of the sons of Elam; Jeshaiah the son of Athaliah, and with him seventy males.
>
> <sup>[8](/bible/ezra/8#v8)</sup> And of the sons of Shephatiah; Zebadiah the son of Michael, and with him fourscore males.
>
> <sup>[9](/bible/ezra/8#v9)</sup> Of the sons of Joab; Obadiah the son of Jehiel, and with him two hundred and eighteen males.
>
> <sup>[10](/bible/ezra/8#v10)</sup> And of the sons of Shelomith; the son of Josiphiah, and with him an hundred and threescore males.
>
> <sup>[11](/bible/ezra/8#v11)</sup> And of the sons of Bebai; Zechariah the son of Bebai, and with him twenty and eight males.
>
> <sup>[12](/bible/ezra/8#v12)</sup> And of the sons of Azgad; Johanan the son of Hakkatan, and with him an hundred and ten males.
>
> <sup>[13](/bible/ezra/8#v13)</sup> And of the last sons of Adonikam, whose names are these, Eliphelet, Jeiel, and Shemaiah, and with them threescore males.
>
> <sup>[14](/bible/ezra/8#v14)</sup> Of the sons also of Bigvai; Uthai, and Zabbud, and with them seventy males.

- The chief of the fathers and their genealogy are recorded, listing the heads of families who went up with Ezra from Babylon and the number of males with each.
- Every name is set down deliberately. These were actual people who put their work into the building of the house, and names mean something, which is why Israel desires their names written in the book.

**[Ezra 8:15-20](/bible/ezra/8#v15)**

> <sup>[15](/bible/ezra/8#v15)</sup> And I gathered them together to the river that runneth to Ahava; and there abode we in tents three days: and I viewed the people, and the priests, and found there none of the sons of Levi.
>
> <sup>[16](/bible/ezra/8#v16)</sup> Then sent I for Eliezer, for Ariel, for Shemaiah, and for Elnathan, and for Jarib, and for Elnathan, and for Nathan, and for Zechariah, and for Meshullam, chief men; also for Joiarib, and for Elnathan, men of understanding.
>
> <sup>[17](/bible/ezra/8#v17)</sup> And I sent them with commandment unto Iddo the chief at the place Casiphia, and I told them what they should say unto Iddo, and to his brethren the Nethinims, at the place Casiphia, that they should bring unto us ministers for the house of our God.
>
> <sup>[18](/bible/ezra/8#v18)</sup> And by the good hand of our God upon us they brought us a man of understanding, of the sons of Mahli, the son of Levi, the son of Israel; and Sherebiah, with his sons and his brethren, eighteen;
>
> <sup>[19](/bible/ezra/8#v19)</sup> And Hashabiah, and with him Jeshaiah of the sons of Merari, his brethren and their sons, twenty;
>
> <sup>[20](/bible/ezra/8#v20)</sup> Also of the Nethinims, whom David and the princes had appointed for the service of the Levites, two hundred and twenty Nethinims: all of them were expressed by name.

- Ezra gathered the company at the river Ahava, abode three days, and viewing the people found none of the sons of Levi, so he sent men of understanding to Iddo at Casiphia to bring ministers for the house.
- By the good hand of the Most High they brought back men of understanding of the sons of Levi and a large number of Nethinims appointed for the service, all expressed by name. Ezra knew which men among him had understanding and called on them.

**[Ezra 8:21-22](/bible/ezra/8#v21)**

> <sup>[21](/bible/ezra/8#v21)</sup> Then I proclaimed a fast there, at the river of Ahava, that we might afflict ourselves before our God, to seek of him a right way for us, and for our little ones, and for all our substance.
>
> <sup>[22](/bible/ezra/8#v22)</sup> For I was ashamed to require of the king a band of soldiers and horsemen to help us against the enemy in the way: because we had spoken unto the king, saying, The hand of our God is upon all them for good that seek him; but his power and his wrath is against all them that forsake him.

- Ezra proclaimed a fast at the river Ahava that they might afflict their souls before the Most High and seek of him a right way for themselves, their little ones, and their substance. To afflict the soul is to fast, taking neither food nor water, and one may fast and pray for wisdom and a right path.
- Ezra was ashamed to require of the king a band of soldiers and horsemen to help against the enemy in the way, having testified that the hand of God is upon all who seek him for good.

  - **[Isaiah 58:5](/bible/isaiah/58#v5)**
    > <sup>[5](/bible/isaiah/58#v5)</sup> Is it such a fast that I have chosen? a day for a man to afflict his soul? is it to bow down his head as a bulrush, and to spread sackcloth and ashes under him? wilt thou call this a fast, and an acceptable day to the Lord?

    The fast the Most High chooses is a day to afflict the soul before him.
  - **[James 1:5](/bible/james/1#v5)**
    > <sup>[5](/bible/james/1#v5)</sup> If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all men liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.

    Lacking wisdom, one may ask of God, who gives liberally, and it shall be given.

The recording ended at [Ezra 8:22](/bible/ezra/8#v22). The remainder of the chapter is included here in full King James text so the chapter is complete for reading and study.

**[Ezra 8:23-36](/bible/ezra/8#v23)**

> <sup>[23](/bible/ezra/8#v23)</sup> So we fasted and besought our God for this: and he was intreated of us.
>
> <sup>[24](/bible/ezra/8#v24)</sup> Then I separated twelve of the chief of the priests, Sherebiah, Hashabiah, and ten of their brethren with them,
>
> <sup>[25](/bible/ezra/8#v25)</sup> And weighed unto them the silver, and the gold, and the vessels, even the offering of the house of our God, which the king, and his counsellors, and his lords, and all Israel there present, had offered:
>
> <sup>[26](/bible/ezra/8#v26)</sup> I even weighed unto their hand six hundred and fifty talents of silver, and silver vessels an hundred talents, and of gold an hundred talents;
>
> <sup>[27](/bible/ezra/8#v27)</sup> Also twenty basons of gold, of a thousand drams; and two vessels of fine copper, precious as gold.
>
> <sup>[28](/bible/ezra/8#v28)</sup> And I said unto them, Ye are holy unto the Lord; the vessels are holy also; and the silver and the gold are a freewill offering unto the Lord God of your fathers.
>
> <sup>[29](/bible/ezra/8#v29)</sup> Watch ye, and keep them, until ye weigh them before the chief of the priests and the Levites, and chief of the fathers of Israel, at Jerusalem, in the chambers of the house of the Lord.
>
> <sup>[30](/bible/ezra/8#v30)</sup> So took the priests and the Levites the weight of the silver, and the gold, and the vessels, to bring them to Jerusalem unto the house of our God.
>
> <sup>[31](/bible/ezra/8#v31)</sup> Then we departed from the river of Ahava on the twelfth day of the first month, to go unto Jerusalem: and the hand of our God was upon us, and he delivered us from the hand of the enemy, and of such as lay in wait by the way.
>
> <sup>[32](/bible/ezra/8#v32)</sup> And we came to Jerusalem, and abode there three days.
>
> <sup>[33](/bible/ezra/8#v33)</sup> Now on the fourth day was the silver and the gold and the vessels weighed in the house of our God by the hand of Meremoth the son of Uriah the priest; and with him was Eleazar the son of Phinehas; and with them was Jozabad the son of Jeshua, and Noadiah the son of Binnui, Levites;
>
> <sup>[34](/bible/ezra/8#v34)</sup> By number and by weight of every one: and all the weight was written at that time.
>
> <sup>[35](/bible/ezra/8#v35)</sup> Also the children of those that had been carried away, which were come out of the captivity, offered burnt offerings unto the God of Israel, twelve bullocks for all Israel, ninety and six rams, seventy and seven lambs, twelve he goats for a sin offering: all this was a burnt offering unto the Lord.
>
> <sup>[36](/bible/ezra/8#v36)</sup> And they delivered the king’s commissions unto the king’s lieutenants, and to the governors on this side the river: and they furthered the people, and the house of God.
